instruction: Set VLC's maximum volume to 200% in the preferences.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media menu, navigated to Open Network Stream, entered HLS URL, and started playback in 11 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC menus, open dialogs, type URLs, interact with VLC UI controls.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC preference modification for volume setting. Agent proved it can navigate VLC menus; now test changing a numeric setting in Tools > Preferences > Interface > Max volume.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Tools > Preferences and setting the maximum volume to 200%. Evaluator kills VLC to force config save, then reads vlcrc to check qt-max-volume setting equals 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config/get_vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which is the right source for preference settings.
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the vlcrc file for the 'qt-max-volume=' key and compares it to the expected value '200', which maps to 200% max volume.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns {'expected_qt_max_volume': '200'}, and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] directly - no incorrect nesting.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading the config, ensuring vlcrc is saved to disk with the latest preferences.
Default value of '125' (VLC's default max volume) ensures correct failure if the setting was never changed.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (set max volume to 200%) is fully verified.
